description: A derived document-link graph over vault pages. It is a projection, not a second store: rebuild it from pages, never write it back into the vault.

node.id: `<vault_id>:<path>`; a node id is scoped to one vault.

edge.provenance: The source path and the literal link target; an unresolved link is reported, never invented.

rules: The graph is derived state; it is never an authority and never a knowledge channel.
Nodes are scoped by vault; an edge never crosses a vault boundary.
Wikilinks may carry an anchor or an alias; both are stripped for resolution.
An unresolved link is reported with its source and literal target.
Node and edge ordering is deterministic so two builds of one corpus are byte-identical.
A page's classification and department travel with the node; the graph does not infer them.
